title: Full repository reachability and dead-artifact audit

method.reachability_definition: An artifact is ACTIVE only when a path exists from a current production entrypoint (a .github/workflows job step) to the code that opens or imports it. A mention in documentation, a test that reads the file, or the file's own claim about itself is never treated as a consumer.
method.model_message_definition: A product/config artifact counts as WIRED only when its content can be traced to the system/user strings handed to src.utils.llm_client.chat (or an injected transport of the same shape) on a path a production entrypoint reaches.
method.dynamic_loading: Dynamically composed paths were traced rather than assumed dead. config/prompts/visibility/*.yaml are loaded through an f-string key (src/editorial/vi_pipeline.py:80) and are WIRED despite having no literal reference.
method.counting: Counts are files measured on a clean worktree and match `git ls-files` (8380). Entries with covers > 1 were assessed as a class; the report names which classes were sampled and how.
method.out_of_scope: Nothing was excluded as vendor/build output: this repository tracks no such directory. reports/content_packages/images/ is the only gitignored generated path and holds no tracked file.

classifications.ACTIVE_RUNTIME: Reachable from a current production entrypoint.
classifications.ACTIVE_SUPPORT: Required by tests, CI, tooling, build, fixtures or operational support, with a demonstrated consumer.
classifications.PRODUCT_CONFIG_WIRED: Authoritative product/config artifact with a proven production consumer.
classifications.PRODUCT_CONFIG_UNWIRED: Intended to control product/runtime behaviour; the required production chain is absent or incomplete.
classifications.HUMAN_DOCUMENTATION: Intentionally for people only; not represented as executable configuration.
classifications.LEGACY_INTENTIONAL: Retained deliberately; owner/reason identified and proven not to be an accidental active path.
classifications.DEAD_ORPHANED: No justified consumer or purpose could be demonstrated.
classifications.DUPLICATE_SUPERSEDED: Another artifact is authoritative; both are named.
classifications.SUSPICIOUS_UNRESOLVED: Purpose or reachability could not be established safely.
